spec_match.rationale: Calls navigator.credentials.get({mediation:'conditional', uiMode:'passive', publicKey, signal}) exactly as the explainer and spec PR define, with uiMode on CredentialRequestOptions (verified against Chromium's credential_request_options.idl).

interactive.rationale: Create passkey (real create()), Start, Abort; live state/elapsed/uiMode meters; decoded assertion output.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises auto-start on capability, live pending state, abort and decoded assertion; all present.

edge_cases.rationale: Missing WebAuthn, synchronous throw, AbortError, NotSupportedError (no authenticator), NotAllowedError (virtual authenticator with no credential) and the flag-off silent fallback are each labelled.

conformance.rationale: Observation route for the passive-ui-shown-with-credentials and no-ui-without-credentials manual assertions; uses the same capability read as conditional-passive-get-capability.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts capability supported/unsupported branches, resolved (challenge echo must match), aborted, rejected, and passkey creation.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled username input, role=status verdicts, output with aria-label, meters as dl/dt/dd, focus restored to Start after Abort and to Create after creation; keyboard path link→input→Create→Start verified.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5068149209825280, the explainer and spec PR w3c/webauthn#2485.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch, in four configurations: default, --enable-features=WebAuthenticationAmbientSignin (+ CDP virtual authenticator), --enable-blink-features=WebAuthenticationAmbient, --enable-experimental-web-platform-features. Zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px horizontal overflow, no sub-44px targets; screenshots read. Flag + virtual authenticator: create() produced a real passkey; Start resolved with a real PublicKeyCredential, clientDataJSON.type webauthn.get and matching challenge. Default: capability verdict 'No', request rejected NotSupportedError (no platform authenticator headless), labelled.

design_system.rationale: Shared ambient.css uses only public/styles.css variables; every button override sets both background and color; verdict colours are emerald-dark/rose on stone (AA).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at both classes with identical outcomes; 0px overflow; single-column at 360px. The underlying feature is a desktop prototype (origin_trial_os win/mac/linux/chromeos); on Android the page reports the capability honestly as not reported rather than hiding controls.

openQuestions.title: Observe the real passive bubble in headed Chrome
openQuestions.detail: Virtual authenticators bypass browser UI, so the non-modal suggestion itself was not seen. Capture a headed Canary run with the flag and a platform passkey, and record its placement and dismissal behaviour.

openQuestions.title: Capability key rename
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 153 reports ambientGet; spec and Chromium main use conditionalPassiveGet. Remove the ambientGet fallback once stable Chrome reports the spec name.

guidanceConsulted.query: passkey sign-in conditional mediation webauthn autofill
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Feature-detect with getClientCapabilities() before conditional get; pass an AbortController signal; segregate NotAllowedError/AbortError; abort pending conditional requests before an explicit prompt.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Capability read gates the auto-start; every request carries a signal with an Abort control; error names are branched explicitly. Exception: no server, so challenges are client-generated and the signature is not verified — stated on the page.

guidanceConsulted.query: non-modal sign-in prompt passkey feature detection getClientCapabilities
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Never infer support from browser name/version or from an accepted option; read the capability key at runtime; unknown dictionary keys are ignored.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Support is read from conditionalPassiveGet/ambientGet only; the page explains that an accepted uiMode value proves nothing.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Discoverable credentials need residentKey: 'required'; use a random non-identifying user handle in production.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: residentKey required; the user handle is the username bytes so it can be shown back — labelled demo-only in ambient.js.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status updates async result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous state changes in a polite status region; keep focus on a surviving control when controls disable/hide.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts use role=status; focus is restored to the originating control when a disabled/hidden control would drop it to body.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Single-column stages on narrow screens, wrap long monospace strings, 44px targets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Meters collapse to one column under 640px; overflow-wrap:anywhere on outputs; measured 0px overflow at 360px and all buttons/inputs >=44px.

summary: The canonical passive request on a form-less page, driven for real: capability-gated auto-start, live pending state, abort, and a decoded real assertion on the flagged path.
